decisions_made.test_strategy: Parameterized test for all behavior-action combinations
decisions_made.test_scope: Create simple one-node graph for each behavior-action pair in StoryBot
decisions_made.test_coverage: Test node creation, instruction extraction, AI call and response, confirmation in both autonomous and interactive modes
decisions_made.parameterization: One test case per behavior-action combination
decisions_made.test_structure: Single parameterized test that iterates through all StoryBot behaviors and actions
decisions_made.graph_complexity: Very simple graph with one BotLangActionNode per test case
decisions_made.mode_coverage: Test both autonomous mode (no pause) and interactive mode (pause for confirmation)
decisions_made.test_organization: All tests use the same parameterized list of behavior-action combinations
decisions_made.test_execution: Each test runs the parameterized list through its own specific verification
decisions_made.integration_test: One final test at the end that goes through the whole sequence of steps
decisions_made.common_helper: All tests use the same common helper for creating bots with behaviors and actions

assumptions_made: One story is specified at a time
Acceptance criteria must be testable, unambiguous, and executable
Gherkin syntax or structured language (Given/When/Then) is preferred
Scenarios are written in plain English without variables or test data
Specification drives both design and test
Scenarios must cover both behavior and domain policy
Examples tables must include ALL variables used in scenario steps
Examples tables must have exact values for both input AND output variables
Every variable must have a corresponding column in Examples table
Examples tables must have actual test data, not placeholders
Output/expected result variables must be included in Examples tables
Examples drive both design and test
Parameterized tests iterate through all behavior-action combinations
Each test creates a simple one-node BotLangFlow graph
Tests verify node creation, instruction extraction, AI interaction, and confirmation
Tests cover both autonomous and interactive BotMode execution
All tests share a common parameterized list of behavior-action pairs
Each test focuses on one aspect (node creation, instructions, AI call, confirmation)
A final integration test validates the complete end-to-end flow
A common helper function creates test bots with specified behaviors and actions
